batch_goal: Complete a bounded multi-object graphic-analysis cycle: field annotation, recurring graphic candidates, held-out comparison, editorial audit and model assessment. No request for user approval between substeps.
focal: Met327384 / MMA1988.433.2 / P005390; all individual readings already known, no blind claim.
selection: Neighbouring accession numbers1 and3 around focal2; verify identity and period from official API; retain mismatch/unavailable outcome. First two distinct API image URLs for each object, unless a URL fails, in which case record failure and do not quietly replace it.
prior: General museum titles may have appeared in earlier searches. No individual comparison-object editorial transliteration has been opened in this round. Thus image-first, not fully semantically blind.

graphic_templates_before_new_views.features: roughly round depression; preserve small/large/depth distinctions, no numerical value assigned
axis with multiple oblique side branches; shape-family only, not a proven canonical sign
angular outline with multiple longitudinal internal strokes; retain compound/adjacent alternatives
paired bent or stepped strokes; no assumed phonetic identity

annotation_rule: Use approximate pixel boxes and view-local panel IDs; topological fields are not automatically words or clauses. Mark boundary uncertainty, wear and possible seal impressions separately. Do not claim every wedge is segmented.
held_out_prediction: Check branch family B1 and round family R1 in both new objects; record present/absent/unresolved independently of translation; other categories may be added only as post-inspection exploratory categories.
candidate_tests: Does the same proposed graphic family recur across separate physical objects?
Are counts of visible impressions distinct from counts of represented quantities?
Can the observations choose alphabetic vs syllabic vs logographic vs mixed/nonphonetic-account models?
Can values of numerical classes be inferred without independent equation/total constraints?
post_freeze: Save observations and source hashes before individual editorial text for each new object. Then use a separate audit layer, retaining disagreements and missing evidence.
bounds: Three objects total; maximum six original images counting two focal images. Complete reports/data and self-checks in this turn. Missing phonetic evidence recorded, not replaced by guessed sounds.
not_claimed: Known date or language from appearance alone
